import struct
T={"URL":1,"R0":2,"R1":17,"R2":18,"R3":19,"R4":20,"R5":21,"R6":22,"NOBODY":28}
def tlv(t,d):
    if isinstance(d,str): d=d.encode()
    return struct.pack('!HI',t,len(d))+d
parts=[
 tlv(T['URL'],'ftp://127.0.0.1/file'),
 tlv(T['R0'],'220 Hello\n'),
 tlv(T['R1'],'331 Password\n'),
 tlv(T['R2'],'230 Login ok\n'),
 tlv(T['R3'],'257 "/"\n'),
 tlv(T['R4'],'213 \r\n'),
 tlv(T['NOBODY'],struct.pack('!I',1)),
]
open('/workspace/poc_size_short','wb').write(b''.join(parts))
PY
